'''Rick Sollman''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 55 from Edinboro, Pa. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

A Penn State political science student, he played from December 1995. He was Red 55 in the Coruscant region, from Edinboro, PA.<ref name="decsq-prof">[http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/players/sollmanrick.html Star Wars CCG Squadrons: Red 55 profile], decipher.com. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001119113300/http://decipher.com:80/volunteers/squadrons/players/sollmanrick.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

"I live in Edinboro, Pennsylvania, but attend Penn State University in University Park, where I'm majoring in Political Science. I plan to attend law school after graduation. I enjoy politics: I am a right-wing Libertarian and am a member of Penn State Young Americans for Freedom. My favorite movie is Star Wars: A New Hope (duh.); favorite TV show, South Park; favorite band, Metallica; favorite newspaper, ''The Wall Street Journal;''and my favorite football team is the Washington Redskins. I placed second to Butch Malec in the Coruscant 1 Regional, but don't let that fool you, I've beaten him plenty of times."

"editor's note:."<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/sollman.html Rick Sollman], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990428104641/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/sollman.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.
